report.answer_text:
Jim proposes to Pam in the Season 5 premiere, "Weight Loss" (Season 5, Episodes 1/2).
Jim proposes at a gas station between New York City, where Pam is taking a graphic design class, and Scranton, where Jim still works at Dunder Mifflin.[1] He proposes to her outside in the pouring rain, and she accepts ecstatically.[2]
Jim had been planning it for a while. In "Chair Model" (Season 4), he shows off the ring he plans to propose with.[3]
The scene was also costly to make. Jenna Fischer said it lasts 52 seconds and cost $250,000, and the crew built a four-lane circular racetrack around the gas station set to create highway traffic.[1]
